messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the person's entire outfit with the complete target outfit shown in the reference images, including the bottoms, the top, and the footwear. Use the first reference image for the front view of the outfit and the second reference image for the back view. Keep only the clothing and footwear belonging to this target outfit, and leave all non-clothing aspects of the person and scene unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to replace the person's whole outfit with the bottoms, the top, and the footwear, as shown from the front and back in the reference images. Keep only the clothing and footwear belonging to this target outfit, and leave all non-clothing aspects unchanged. The first reference image shows the front view of the complete outfit, and the second shows its back view.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"He stands in place, turns his head and body, and repeatedly touches his collar and chest area with one hand.","camera":"Medium shot at roughly waist height with a static framing that keeps the character centered.","clothing":"White long-sleeve shirt under a black-and-white sleeveless vest, red pants with black patches, and a brown belt with a silver buckle.","hair_color":"Light brown.","hairstyle":"Short hair on the sides with a small top-knot bun at the crown.","identity":"A 3D-rendered young man with dark skin and a slim build, shown from the thighs up.","scene":"An outdoor amusement park at dusk, with a swing ride on the left, a carousel-style structure with lights on the right, and a striped umbrella cart nearby."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The character's light blue sweater and gray pants were replaced with a white long-sleeve shirt, black-and-white sleeveless vest, red pants with black patches, and a brown belt. The upper-body framing remains similar, and the amusement park scene and character motion are largely preserved.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the person's entire outfit with the reference outfit: white long-sleeve shirt under a black-and-white sleeveless vest, red pants with black patches, brown belt, and black shoes, while preserving the person and scene.
uncertain: Footwear is not visible in the medium shot, so the black shoes from the reference could not be verified.
unexpected_changes: The output framing appears slightly tighter/cropped compared with the source, though the character and scene remain the same.
